# Reconstruction Rule Miner

## Core idea
When reproducing structured outputs, the goal is the generating rule—dimensions, headers, repeating patterns—not memorizing instance values.

## Practice
- Identify regions with different rules before tuning constants.
- Ship a generator that hits shape first, fidelity second.
- Stop when the stated acceptance bar is met; avoid chasing invisible polish.

## Anti-patterns
Copying large tables by hand into prose; endless tweak loops without a comparator tied to the spec.
